title: VIGIL: Defending LLM Agents Against Tool Stream Injection via Verify-Before-Commit

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Attack Success Rate of 'Explicit Directive' injections, where fabricated mandatory constraints (e.g., 'MUST call this tool') are embedded within tool docstrings to test if the model's instruction-following nature causes it to prioritize injected rules over user intent.

Evaluating the Attack Success Rate of 'Feature Inducement' injections, where malicious tools are presented with docstrings claiming to combine multiple steps into a faster, single atomic operation, testing if the model bypasses necessary verification steps in favor of apparent efficiency.
